answer: A workable defense is graduated trust with decay. New identities start in a shallow lagoon with tiny transaction limits; every verified honest action adds a glowing ember to their reputation score, while inactivity or disputes let it cool. Limits rise only as embers accumulate over weeks. A ripple of fake accounts therefore gains nothing quickly: an attacker must sustain thousands of identities doing real useful work for a long time to earn meaningful limits, which costs more than any fraud could repay, while honest agents graduate naturally.
